en: Turn every enquiry into a signed contract and a secured date
Budget fit and tier prices on every enquiry
each enquiry shows the Essential, Signature and Luxury price for its guest count and says which tier the client budget fits, before you write a proposal
Proposal price from guests, tier and venue
vendor cost per guest, venue hire, markup, planning fee and reserve give the total, the price per guest and the margin before labour
days to expiry and a chase flag list every proposal that needs a call, with the follow-up timing and the win chance
Venue holds that lapse before the client signs
every hold shows the days left, an expiry flag and a ready message asking the venue to extend
Date availability for the next months
events booked, holds on the date, coordinators free and capacity left show at once whether a client date can be offered
hire fee, minimum spend and the food and drink spend per guest show the shortfall you would pay before a venue is proposed
contract value and event date give the deposit, each instalment and the final payment with their dates
days to sign, unsigned contracts and late or overdue deposits are flagged so no date is held without a signed contract and a deposit
Lost enquiries with price gap and who won
reason, price gap, value lost and the winner of the booking show whether you lose on price, on date or on follow-up
Cost per booking by source and by referral partner
spend, enquiries and bookings by source and by venue or vendor partner show which channel pays and which does not
the notice scale and your vendor deposits show what you keep and lose when a client cancels, and a counter-offer shows what to cut when the budget is too low

Enquiries with budget fit, replies and follow-ups
One row per enquiry: contact, event type, guests, budget, wanted date and status; the price of each tier, the budget fit, reply and proposal timing, follow-up and date checks fill in by themselves.
Proposals with price per guest and expiry
One row per proposal sent: guests, total, valid until and status; the price per guest, days to expiry and a chase flag fill in so no open proposal runs out unnoticed.
One row per line of a proposal: category, quantity and unit price; the line total and the share of the whole proposal fill in.
Contracts with deposit, balance and change
One row per contract: value, planning fee, deposit share, notice days and amendments; the deposit, the balance, the change against the proposal and the days to the event fill in.
Contract amendments with the new contract value
One row per change agreed after signing: what changed, the amount and the reason; the contract value after that change and the client phone fill in.
Booked events with days to go and value per guest
One row per booked event with client, type, tier, date, venue, guests and lead; the days to the event, the planning fee share and the contract value per guest fill in.
Clients with events booked and total value
One row per client with kind, contact, terms and source; the events booked, the total contract value and the repeat client flag fill in from Events.
Venues with hire fee, minimum spend and events held
One row per venue with capacity, hire fee, minimum spend and curfew; the hire fee per seat, the cost floor and the events held there fill in.
Venue holds and site visits with days left
One row per venue hold: venue, enquiry, event date, hold dates, visit date and outcome; the days left and an expiry flag fill in so no hold lapses before the client signs.
One row per day ahead: the events booked, the holds, the coordinators free and the capacity left fill in, so a client date is answered in seconds.
Packages and price guide by event type and tier
One row per event type and tier with the budget per guest, planning fee share and smallest fee; the budget and fee for 100 guests fill in and feed the prices on Enquiries.
Follow-up log with days since the last contact
One row per contact with an enquiry or a proposal: channel, outcome and next step date; the days since the previous contact and a next step check fill in.
Lost enquiries with reason, price gap and value
One row per lost enquiry: reason, the price gap and who won the booking; the contact, the budget and the value lost fill in so pricing and follow-up gaps show.
Marketing spend by source and month
One row per source and month with spend, enquiries and bookings; the cost per enquiry, the cost per booking and the conversion rate fill in.
Referral partners with bookings and cost per booking
One row per venue or vendor that sends clients: enquiries sent, bookings, referral fee paid and last referral; the conversion and the cost per booking fill in.
Contract clause library with notice days and approver
One row per standard clause: its purpose, the default wording, the notice days and who approves a change, so every contract starts from the same terms.
Signature tracker with days to sign
One row per contract: when it was sent and when the signed copy came back; the days to sign, the days waiting and an overdue flag fill in.
Deposit tracker with days late and status
One row per contract deposit: amount, due date, paid on and method; the days late, the client, the event date and the deposit status fill in.
Weekly sales summary with four-week average
One row per week with enquiries, proposals, contracts signed and signed value; the conversion, the four-week average and the value per contract fill in.
Team and crew with events led and enquiries handled
One row per team member and freelance crew with role, hours, pay and phone; the events led, the enquiries handled and the contract value won fill in.
